outcome.analysis_limit: The outer Environment response could navigate back to offset zero, but a consumer holding only the compact projection did not receive that exact previous-page cursor. The page-local pressure state did not mean the pressure was absent from campaign history.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Capability projections omit the previous evidence page cursor
pressure_hypothesis.basis: A live page at offset 24 with limit 32 returned previous offset zero in the campaign-state envelope while the compact capability projection exposed the current page and null next offset without the previous offset.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Carry the exact previous evidence offset, including null at the first page, through full and compact capability projections.
